name: test-on-save
description: Run parser/unit/property tests when addon or companion source changes.

then.comment: Runs the addon suite (luac + busted) and the companion suite when present.
then.command: sh -c 'set -e; if [ -f addon/tests/run.sh ]; then sh addon/tests/run.sh; fi; if [ -f companion/src-tauri/Cargo.toml ] && command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then (cd companion/src-tauri && cargo test); fi'
